# `surface_frames`

a surface's canonical frames (from its registered sphere) and its anatomical frame.

Version 1, scope `subject`. Run it with `nxr-neuro run surface_frames --dataset <folder> --subject <id> ...`; `nxr-neuro run surface_frames --help` prints the same options.

Examples:

```
nxr-neuro run surface_frames --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --surface cortex [--template fsaverage --template-surface cortex_pial]
```

## Inputs

| input | what it is | required |
|---|---|---|
| `surface` | manifold surface, where {"name": "$surface"} | yes |

## Parameters

Each is an option `--<name> VALUE` (dashes for underscores; the value is read as YAML) or `--set NAME=VALUE`.

| parameter | option | default | unit | choices | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `surface` | `--surface` | none | - |  | the surface by name |
| `template` | `--template` | none | - |  | a template subject of the dataset whose anatomical frame is carried through the registered spheres; null: the surface's own axes |
| `template_surface` | `--template-surface` | none | - |  | the template's surface; null: its primary one |
| `convention` | `--convention` | `scs` | - | scs, ras | the coordinates the surface's own axes are in: scs (anterior +x, left +y, superior +z) \| ras |
| `side` | `--side` | `auto` | - | auto, left, right | a one-piece surface's hemisphere: auto (each piece by position) \| left \| right |
| `min_projection` | `--min-projection` | `0.34` | - |  | reliable where the anterior axis projects on the tangent plane with at least this length (sin 20 degrees) |
| `max_condition` | `--max-condition` | `50.0` | - |  | canonical frames: a vertex whose push-forward Jacobian is worse is singular |

## The chain of nodes

| phase | node | in | with | out |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before | [`geometry.surface_frames`](../nodes.md) | surface=surface | template=$template, template_surface=$template_surface, convention=$convention, side=$side, min_projection=$min_projection, max_condition=$max_condition | canonical, singular, gauge_angle, angle, second, handed, reliable |

`before` steps run once, `chunks` steps run on every chunk of the recording, `after` steps run once on what the chunks accumulated.

| output | stored as |

| `reliable` | kind selection, type indices, name {surface}_anatomical_reliable, on surface.manifold.0 |

## Notes from the definition

```text
THE FRAMES OF A SURFACE: the canonical frames (north e1, west e2 = n x e1, n outward) pushed forward from the registered sphere `<surface>_sphere` when they are not stored yet,
their singular vertices (the poles, ill-conditioned push-forwards) and the angle of north in geometry-central's gauge (with its gauge record); and the anatomical frame, from the
surface's own axes in the stated convention or carried from a template subject's through the registered spheres: the angle from north to anterior, which way the second axis
points (0 superior, 1 medial) and its sign, and the vertices where it is reliable (the anterior axis projects on the tangent plane with at least min_projection).

  nxr-neuro run surface_frames --dataset <folder> --subject sub-01 --surface cortex [--template fsaverage --template-surface cortex_pial]
```
